summary: V6.19 backend verified: 16/16 pytest pass. Formula rebalance correct — tier=20/flat=20/curve=30 at L5; Eli-equivalent TEST character with stored 90 DP recomputes to 20 DP (previous=90, new=20, formula=flat). /api/anime5e/races returns all 8 races with DP costs in 1-5 range + tier table [10,20,40,60,80]. budget-breakdown returns tier metadata (Tier 2, dp=20) and flags suspicious_budget=true when stored 90>150% of 20. class-progression returns full Artificer L5 block. Surprise Bag + Scene-Break Cards: seed idempotent, draw returns a random entry, GM-only enforcement verified (Aurora→403 on draw, create, and Scene-Break create). IMPORTANT — review request's character/campaign IDs were ALL STALE (DB appears to have been reset; Eli doesn't exist). Tests adapted to create a TEST_V619_AnimeEli Artificer L5 in the live anime-5e campaign 2d31c25354e4415f84a31704fe78a795. Frontend BUG FOUND + FIXED: AtelierWorkshop.jsx lines 110/367 used bare confirm() which ESLint no-restricted-globals blocks — whole app failed to compile. Changed to window.confirm(). UI not fully re-verified after fix due to HMR cycle timing.
